guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for ASE atoms properties by analyzing info and calculator results from a list of atoms
guess_target_metadata: guess whether target samples are per-atom or per-image and if the property is intensive or extensive
check_target_extensive: check if a target property is extensive by comparing per-atom normalized variation against a threshold
check_target_per_atom: check if target samples are per-atom by verifying the first dimension matches atom count
check_uniform_atoms_lengths: check if all structures in a list have the same number of atoms
